propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherited generic 16,000-token, three-generation, four-transport-attempt, and 600-second budgets without operation-local bounds, causing 216–311 second runtimes and malformed runaway candidate_id responses before safe abstention.

RunRequest lacked explicit structured-retry, transport-attempt, and timeout ceilings; token-cap mutations alone did not prevent three generations, proving output size alone was insufficient containment.

Repair extends RunRequest with lowering-only per-request seams for output tokens, structured retries, transport attempts, and timeout; overlap judge now requests 1,024 tokens, one generation, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout.
_effective_config applies timeout and transport ceilings before model/provider construction to reach anthropic_model.py and bedrock_model.py transport layer.
Timeout, truncation, and malformed output each degrade to exact all-candidate abstention without fabricated overlap findings, restoring documented intent from story 9022 and ADR 0086.
Existing callers omitting request-local limits retain current defaults; repair is isolated to judge_batch with no external effect or new dependency surface.
